A robed grey wizard atop a rocky outcrop, gnarled staff thrust high, both arms spread wide, his cloak whipping as the colossal spell erupts above and dwarfs him.
A sorceress in flowing black-and-violet robes, arcane fire spiralling from both upraised hands, head thrown back, a tiny figure against the storm of power she conjures.
An armored battle-mage on one knee, a glowing runed greatsword driven into the ground, channeling a torrent of energy upward through the blade, dwarfed by its eruption.
A hooded warlock, dark leather coat billowing, an eldritch tome floating open before him, both hands splayed as crackling void-light pours outward and swallows his slight silhouette.
A horned tiefling conjurer in scarlet robes, tail curled with effort, clawed hands tracing blazing sigils mid-air, her small form eclipsed by the infernal summoning unfolding above her.
An ancient lich-mage in tattered gold-trimmed finery, skeletal arms outstretched, empty eye sockets blazing, a diminutive withered figure swallowed by the apocalyptic necrotic storm he commands.
An elven archmage in silver robes and a starlight circlet, slender arms raised in precise geometric gestures, her delicate form a pale sliver beneath towering cascades of conjured radiance.
A druid in bark-plate armour, antlered staff planted in cracked earth, arms flung wide as colossal lightning pours from storm-clouds he called, his figure tiny at the tempest's eye.
A blood-mage in crimson-streaked grey robes, palms pressed together then thrust apart, glowing wound-sigils hanging in the air around her, her body small and shaking amid the vast crimson eruption.
Two rival wizards facing each other across scorched ground, robes of midnight blue and ember red, each hurling a pillar of opposing magic that towers over both their diminutive duelling forms.
A young apprentice in an oversized brown robe, arms flung outward in alarm, expression wide with terror as the titanic spell she accidentally unleashed billows enormous and uncontrolled above her.

A crowned sorcerer-king in gilded ceremonial robes, sceptre levelled like a weapon, chin raised with cold authority, his regal figure dwarfed entirely by the obliterating wave of golden power he unleashes.

A sea-witch in saltwater-soaked green silks, coral staff raised overhead with both hands, silver hair lashing in conjured gales, her slender body minuscule beneath a towering pillar of churning ocean magic.

A dwarven runesmith in heavy iron-banded robes, hammer engraved with blazing runes held high in one fist, stocky frame braced and small against the mountainous surge of forge-fire magic erupting upward.
A masked plague-doctor warlock in stained leather coat and beaked mask, one hand extended holding a black vial aloft, her figure swallowed in the colossal sickly green miasma billowing from it.

A bare-armed tribal shaman, body painted with glowing ochre sigils, feathered headdress streaming, spear raised with both hands, dwarfed by the enormous ancestor-spirit storm materialising in thunderous coils above him.

A blind oracle in tattered white wrappings, arms crossed then flung wide, sightless face tilted upward, her frail form utterly insignificant beneath the vast celestial beam of prophetic light she channels.

A half-orc battle-sorcerer in cracked plate, tusked jaw set hard, one gauntleted fist glowing with barely contained arcane force, her hulking figure still small against the detonating sphere of power it releases.

A fey enchantress in gossamer robes trailing illusory petals, both hands drawing shimmering threads from thin air, her lithe dancing form a delicate silhouette against the immense blooming glamour she weaves.

A scholarly mage-archivist in ink-stained layered robes, three books orbiting him open, fingers tracing multiple glyphs simultaneously, his slight hunched form dwarfed by the latticed arcane superstructure erupting from his equations.

A shadow-dancer rogue-mage in close-fitted black, twin void-imbued daggers crossed overhead, crouched low, her compact silhouette nearly swallowed by the enormous eruption of pooling living darkness she commands around her.

A nomadic sand-mage in desert wrappings and amber goggles, arms flung wide as whirling columns of enchanted sand and crackling heat-lightning spiral enormous from her outstretched hands, shrinking her to nothing.

An undead revenant sorcerer in decayed nobleman's finery, one skeletal hand thrust skyward and one pressed to a cracked ribcage, his crumbling form insignificant against the vast ghostly conflagration he unleashes.

A celestial cleric-mage in shining vestments and broken halo, both hands clasped in desperate prayer then forced apart, her kneeling figure made tiny by the blinding divine pillar tearing the sky open.

A goblin chaos-mage in mismatched stolen robes, cackling with arms thrown wide, wild eyes alight, her tiny green body utterly dwarfed by the enormous spiralling catastrophe of multicoloured wild magic exploding above her.
